title: Ukraine, Russia and US face second day of talks after night of attacks by Moscow – Europe live
summary: Russian attacks on Ukraine killed at least one and wounded dozens Russia’s large overnight strike on Ukrainian energy facilities showed that agreements on air defence made with US president Donald Trump in Davos this week must be “fully implemented,” president Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on Saturday. Zelenskyy and Trump met at the World Economic Forum on Thursday and discussed air defence support for Ukraine, although afterwards neither leader specified what was agreed. Continue reading...

title: Reform UK’s private health insurance plan would cost £1.7bn, Streeting to say
summary: Health secretary will describe plan to offer tax relief on private healthcare as ‘tax cut for the wealthiest’ Reform UK’s policy of tax relief on private health insurance could cost the country £1.7bn, the health secretary, Wes Streeting, is expected to say on Saturday. Streeting will make the claim at a conference organised by the Fabian Society, a socialist thinktank aligned to the Labour party, and will describe the Reform proposal as a “tax cut for the wealthiest”. Continue reading...

title: China’s Highest-Ranking General Removed as Xi’s Military Purge Reaches the Top
summary: General Zhang Youxia had appeared to be President Xi Jinping’s trusted second-in-command. He has now joined the long list of generals and admirals under investigation.

title: Australian Boy, 12, Dies After Shark Attack Near Sydney
summary: Nico Antic died in a hospital after a shark bit him in the legs, the first of several recent shark attacks along Australia’s southeastern coast.

title: Ukraine Under Massive Russian Attack as UAE Talks Continue
summary: Kyiv and other Ukrainian regions came under a massive Russian drone and missile attack overnight as talks continue between US, Russian and Ukrainian officials in the United Arab Emirates aimed at finding a path to end to the war.
